'''Witch Hill''' is an area in [[Dustwallow Marsh]], located about a third of the way down the peninsula on the way to [[Theramore Island]] (or northwest from there). Near its center is [[Swamplight Manor]], home of [["Swamp Eye" Jarl]]. It also contains a few camps of the [[Mirefin]] [[murloc]] tribe.
